name: Clear Blue Skies
source:
Riley has encountered multiple episodes regarding her fall into the ocean on a train when she was a teenager. 

She only remembers fragments of her memories and has is now talking to her doctor about this. 

Go down memory lane in this first instalment with Riley to uncover her memories and to understand her story. 

Never judge a book by its cover, or in this case, a person by their perfect smile.

[From [url=https://strxwberrybliss.itch.io/clear-blue-skies-part-one]itch.io[/url]]
